:::{#fig-logit}

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

odds <- function(pi) pi / (1 - pi)

logit <- function(p) log(odds(p))

library(ggplot2)
logit_plot <-
  ggplot() +
  geom_function(
    fun = logit,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both")
  ) +
  xlim(.001, .999) +
  ylab("logit(p)") +
  xlab("Probability, p") +
  theme_bw()
print(logit_plot)
```
